name: News Brief
tagline: A weekly digest of the stories that lasted, stated as facts with any slant labelled
description: Once a week it picks out the stories that kept developing, not the ones that flared and died. Each item is written as a plain statement of what happened, drawn from outlets across the political spectrum, and any slant it finds in the coverage is named outright. A calm answer to feeds that reward outrage.
